purpose: Before any long training, test whether a small permutation-invariant node head can memorize the geometry-semantic node targets from frozen causal-LiDAR primitive predictions on a tiny family-balanced development subset.

sampling.rule: Use only the c1_mixed C01 task from each S01-S10 family. Per family choose two degree-1 nodes with one arrival each, two degree>=3 nodes with two arrivals each, then six degree-2 nodes with two arrivals each: exactly 18 observations and 10 nodes per family.

raw_sources: sealed P1a C01 causal 5-frame LiDAR shards
sealed P1b C01 primitive composition targets
source.license_or_allowed_use: Project-generated research assets; upstream redistribution conditions remain unchanged.

teacher.source: The sealed construction program selects the incident primitive ports and supplies a 44-D rotation/slot/pose-invariant node target plus degree. Node identity is used only to form same/different loss labels.
teacher.valid_mask: Only final traversal observations with a valid five-frame P1b sequence are eligible; all 180 selected observations have at least one valid incident port.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph/planner runs. The already passed 16 m graph-consistency capacity proof remains a prerequisite; traversal-only edge validation is deferred.
teacher.student_inputs: Frozen endpoint geometry features and endpoint confidence derived only from five causal LiDAR scans and relative odometry.

split.fit: The same 180 C01 observations are optimized and evaluated because this is deliberately a memorization/readiness gate, not a generalization result.
split.selection: C07 is listed for isolation but read count must remain zero.
split.strict_test: C08-C10 and M-TARE read count must remain zero.
split.historical_pollution_audit: No historical graph result, endpoint identity prediction or C07/C08 error selects the 180 rows; selection is fixed by family, C01, realization, node degree and lexical identity.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.optimization: Exactly 500 full-batch head-only AdamW updates, lr 0.003 and weight decay 0; frozen primitive backbone unchanged.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.loss: Final total loss must improve at least 95% from initialization; geometry descriptor RMSE <=0.01.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.association: On the same-task tiny pair population, a tie-safe nonempty operating point must achieve precision >=0.99 and recall >=0.95.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.system: All head gradients finite, frozen feature replay exact, final replay exact, source state unchanged and zero C07-C10/graph/M-TARE.

estimated_cost.compute: One frozen-backbone feature pass over 180 sequences plus 500 full-batch small-head updates

failure_policy: Any failure stops before one-seed training. Do not increase steps, inspect C07, alter the sample, lower gates or unfreeze the backbone inside this run.
retention: Keep compact frozen features, 180-row manifest, tiny head checkpoint, loss history, environment, logs, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

approval.scope: One immutable 180-observation/500-step seed0 tiny-overfit gate; zero C07-C10, graph or M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed continuous autonomous execution, automatic optimal in-scope decisions and no routine approval prompts.
